verified_source_anchors.description: FHIR R4 collection export endpoint enforcing purpose-bound authorization and medical disclaimer consent.
Validates export purpose and resolves scoped profile authorization context.
Constructs canonical health snapshot enforcing delegate data class boundaries and filtering active events.
Fail-closed check raising HTTP 428 Precondition Required when active medical disclaimer consent is absent or revoked.
Profile authorization resolver enforcing RBAC, IDOR defense, and FamilyAccessGrant temporal and action boundaries.
Transforms snapshot into strict FHIR R4 collection bundle with Patient, Observation, MedicationStatement, Consent, and Provenance.
Automated integration test suite covering mobile consented share, consent gating, purpose validation, IDOR defense, and conformance boundaries.

tests_run.command: DATABASE_URL=sqlite+pysqlite:////tmp/clara_api_ci.db AUTH_AUTO_PROVISION_USERS=true AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_ENABLED=true uv run pytest -v tests/test_mobile_consented_fhir_share.py
tests_run.description: All 18 mobile consented FHIR share integration tests passed cleanly.
Path lane conformance verified across services/api/tests/ and artifacts/PH11/A07/.

mobile_consented_fhir_share_tests.finding: Implemented test_mobile_consented_fhir_share.py covering 18 integration scenarios: full export workflow (Patient, Observation with UCUM units, MedicationStatement with dosage and coding, Consent, Provenance), consent gating and revocation (HTTP 428), purpose validation (HTTP 422), unauthenticated rejection (HTTP 401), cross-user IDOR protection (HTTP 404), admin direct access prevention without break-glass (HTTP 404), family delegate boundaries (expired, revoked, missing action, and missing data class fail closed; active succeeds), feature flag disabling (HTTP 404), IPS overclaim prevention (HTTP 409), non-general server conformance, demographic data minimization, and draft filtering.
